message.content:
**Pet‑friendly train station in Miami** | Station | Address | Train services | Pet policy | |---------|---------|----------------|------------| | **Miami Intermodal Center (MIA)** | 1 SE 1st Ave, Miami, FL 33131 | • Amtrak (Silver Service – Silver Meteor & Silver Star)
• Tri‑Rail (regional commuter)
• Metrorail (Metrobus connections) | • **Tri‑Rail** – Small pets (dogs, cats, birds, etc.) are allowed in a carrier that fits under the seat. The carrier must be secured and the pet must remain inside it for the duration of the trip.
• **Amtrak** – Pets are permitted on most long‑haul routes, but only one pet per passenger and the pet must be in a carrier that fits under the seat. Amtrak’s “Pet Friendly” policy applies to the Silver Service trains that stop at MIA.
• The station itself does not have dedicated pet relief areas, but the trains’ pet‑friendly policy makes it the de‑facto pet‑friendly hub for rail travel in Miami. | ### Why it’s considered pet‑friendly * **Train‑level pet allowance** – Both Tri‑Rail and Amtrak allow pets in carriers, so you can bring your dog or cat along on the journey without needing a separate pet transport service. * **Central location** – The Intermodal Center sits right next to the Miami International Airport and is connected to the Metrorail, making it easy to transfer between air, rail, and bus while keeping your pet with you. * **Accessibility** – The station is fully ADA‑compliant, with elevators, ramps, and clear signage, so you can navigate it comfortably with a pet. ### How to confirm before you go | Service | Contact | Notes | |---------|---------|-------| | **Tri‑Rail** | Phone: 305‑284‑4000 | Call ahead to confirm pet policy and any changes. | | **Amtrak** | Phone: 800‑733‑7300 | Ask about the specific route you’ll be taking (Silver Meteor/Star). | | **Miami Intermodal Center** | Phone: 305‑284‑4000 (same as Tri‑Rail) | The same line handles general inquiries for the station. | --- #### Quick tip If you’re traveling with a larger dog or a pet that needs more space, consider booking a **pet‑friendly cabin** on Amtrak’s Silver Service or a **pet‑friendly seat** on Tri‑Rail. Both services allow you to reserve a carrier in advance, ensuring you have a spot for your furry friend. Enjoy your trip—your pet will be welcome aboard!
